resources.string: Manage domains trusted by the built-in Russian root CA

The built-in Russian root CA is trusted only for the built-in zones and domains you explicitly add. A domain entry also covers its subdomains. Public suffixes and wildcards are not allowed. Changes apply to new certificate checks.
The built-in Russian root CA will no longer be trusted for this domain or its subdomains.
Enter a valid DNS domain without a scheme, path, port, IP address, or wildcard.
Public suffixes such as .com, .net, or .org cannot be added.
This domain is already covered by .ru, .рф, or .su.
This domain is already in the list.
The limit of 100 additional domains has been reached.
